facts.fact: The BCRG, through the Guineenne de la Monetique (GuiM) it steers, launched NimbaPay on 22 July 2026 as the national instant and interoperable payment platform linking banks, e-money institutions and microfinance, per Guineenews.

systems.owner: Guineenne de la Monetique (GuiM), under the BCRG

GIN.note: No consumer rules or complaints body stated.
Cross-border flows only named as a later step.
Digitalisation of state payments only named as a later step; none routed through the platform.
Account access of close to 36% in 2024 is given with no survey named.

facts.fact: NimbaPay, launched 22 July 2026, lets anyone in Guinea send and receive money instantly between a bank, a microfinance institution and an e-money establishment, per Governor Karamo Kaba.
NimbaPay is described as the national instant and interoperable payment platform running 24/7 across banks, e-money institutions and microfinance, per the GuiM director general.
Governor Kaba says account access rose from 4% in 2011 to close to 36% in 2024 notably through electronic money, so e-money is in service.

systems.owner: Guineenne de la Monetique (GuiM), under the BCRG

GIN.note: Nothing on tax or fee collection.
